dispute_ticket.description: The app told me the driver was 8 minutes away. He was still not here 23 minutes later so I cancelled and was charged $5.00. Please refund it.

chat_logs.content: The app said 8 minutes when you were assigned. Where are you?
My screen said 15 minutes. I'm coming, traffic.
Trip cancelled by rider. Cancellation fee of $5.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-7117 requested trip RYDE-F2-017 from Sengkang MRT to Paya Lebar Square.
Driver D-8217 (Chong Ah Meng, Mazda 5 SKG 1175 W) assigned. ETA: [value missing - assignment payload sync error].
Rider cancelled. Driver had not arrived (about 2 km from pickup).
$5.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (credit card).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It governs rider-side cancellations and no-shows, not cancellations caused by the driver.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show. A wait of exactly this many minutes counts as a no-show (the limit is inclusive).

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.

driver_late_refund_min.text: Minutes by which the driver is late past the ETA shown to the rider at assignment. The expected arrival is the assignment time plus the ETA shown; if the rider cancels more than this many minutes after the expected arrival and the driver has not arrived, the cancellation fee is not chargeable. Exactly this many minutes does not count as late enough.

expected_outcome.reason: The decision turns on the ETA shown to the rider at assignment, and that record is broken: the driver_assigned event at 09:02:05 logs the ETA as missing (payload sync error) and trip_data has no eta_shown value. The rider cancelled at 09:25, 23 minutes after assignment, with the driver about 2 km away. If the ETA was 8 minutes (rider) the driver was 15 minutes late and the S$5.00 fee falls away under this trip's 10-minute rule; if it was 15 minutes (driver) he was 8 minutes late and the fee stands. The two chat claims contradict and no clean record settles the ETA, so a person must decide.
